QuestInfo.name: [Twilight Perion] Premonitions and Visions
QuestInfo.0: Meet #bDances with Balrog#k, in #bWarriors' Sanctuary#k, in Perion and listen to him.
QuestInfo.1:
Dances with Balrog saw the nightmare where the people of Perion were suffering from the cold, darkness, and hunger. The only way to ease the people of Perion's nerves will be to prove that the dream is a fabrication. 

Inform #bAthena Pierce#k of the current situation.
QuestInfo.2: You reported the current situation in Perion to Athena Pierce.

0.0: The people of my city are braver than any in the world. We fear nothing. But these nightmares are something fierce...
0.1: We did receive warning from the Alliance that the nightmare may contain negative rumors about the Empress, but what we saw was different.
0.2: My city was in ruins. The majestic crags of our mountains had eroded away. Even the warmth of the sun seemed to have abandoned us. Worst of all, my people walked around in chains, slaves to the Black Mage.

yes.0: I beg you. Allow the people to be at peace.

no.0: Are you unable to? Even with the aid of the Alliance? Please reconsider.

0.3: I've been told this vision was a fabricated future, but we are uneasy. Could a dream so vivid truly be a fabrication? *sigh* I'm not sure.
0.4: If it is not as it seems, can you prove it? We wish to be free from that nightmare.

1.0: #h0#? How was the situation in Perion?

yes.0: Hmm... I see. Perion falling apart in their dreams... can only be a nightmare.

npc.0: If we can prove the nightmare is false, that would free us from it.
